provenance.reading_notes: Master do-file organizes analysis into publicly runnable programs (2-7 using CPS/DOL data) and confidential programs (1,8-12 using EEO-1/Glassdoor/BGT data). Reading focused on estimation specifications from programs 2, 5, 8, 11 which represent main analyses for employment (EEO-1) and posted wages (BGT) with supporting CPS analyses. Two main research designs identified: (1) NC sharp DiD post July 2013 vs Southern/Midwestern controls; (2) Staggered DiD with 6 moderate reform states (FL/GA/KS/MI/MO/SC) with state-specific reform dates.

repository.directory_layout: Monolithic do-files in single directory (code/zenodo_20014224/.../do-files/); no separate data or script subdirectories in archive. Outputs written to $FIGSTABSDIR and $OUTPUTDATADIR globals.
